evidence: Reverse-mapped all 93 shipped criteria (2 gates, 79 Functional, 6 Polish, 6 Visual), including their complete protocols, against public instructions. Paths below are relative to the frozen task. Startup/examples and filename dispatch follow instruction.md and overview.md; execution, errors, console, Auto-run and Save outcomes follow environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5-29; sandbox, unsupported-family and text-only storage probes follow security.md:3-11; restart collection/example checks follow integration.md:9; editor, keyboard, themes and presentation follow ui.md:3-9 plus ordinary usable-product defaults. No unrequired demand found. In particular, behaviour.md:11-15 explicitly supports completed-preview interaction, Stop preservation and source-line errors, matching tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:149-171; policy.md:5 leaves routes/labels/layout free, respected by functional/prompt.md:11-19 and both gates. Conforming alternatives examined: hidden provisional candidate and static rollback are explicitly accepted at functional/prompt.md:17,159-171; ordinary Escape/Tab without help text is accepted at scored/polish/prompt.md:29-30,47; server-rendered library data and alternative endpoint shapes are accepted by constraints/judge.toml:25-27; native/simple presentation can earn full credit in visual/judge.toml:40,55,70,85. A plausible dead-timer implementation cannot establish cancellation merely from silence: functional/prompt.md:179 requires the matching callback/error to work first, and S36:479-486 requires successful nested callbacks. This is a source-level counterexample assessment, not an executed mutant. Verified all 102 indexed current-golden artifact hashes. RESULTS.json functional/prompt hashes equal frozen bytes (94fe96a876b1ea5fc325bd189a674b232d61c6016256f2685caca4fb69b1f00b / 418db1996ffabafb6023ee24ab0235bc861db23c87e9fec505e22c9cdb8cf770). Raw post-results S03 shows input value 'a' preserved before/after Stop and 'late-interaction-failure ? line 5' with interaction-latest-good restored. These observations support feasibility only; the index explicitly leaves configured judge workload, Oracle/model scores and empirical ranking unmeasured. No such measurements are claimed or waived by this semantic row.
